card.text: A Cepheid in the Large Magellanic Cloud that swells and shrinks every 39.4 days.

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 156.6 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 46,154 parsecs away.

color.title: Colour
color.summary: The colour of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
